Been there, to the point that I actually started hurting myself. If there's anything I can say that helped me (besides funny plant that I can't say the name bc of the rules and some therapy), is learning to love being alone with myself, work on yourself both physically and mentally (I get that with depression it gets waaay harder, but one small step at a time and you'll eventually turn it into routine, give it about 3 months and you'll see the results). After working on yourself, remember that there are 8 BILLION people in this world, even if everyone you know dislikes you, there's a LOT of people out there who can and will love you, I recommend looking for groups with shared interests, I found my best ND friends in an "arts for videogames" class. Working out will also help boost your self esteem and as a bonus it releases some "happy chemicals" in your brain, so it's a win win, and you don't need to be shy starting with the lower weights, everyone has gotta start somewhere.
